label: Create table agentRoleSettings
summary: Creates table agentRoleSettings with required columns

precheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ? AND "name" = ?)

execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE "agentRoleSettings" (
  "backend" TEXT,
  "effort" TEXT,
  "model" TEXT,
  "role" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "scope" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  PRIMARY KEY ("scope", "role")
)

postcheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ? AND "name" = ?)

label: Carry captain settings onto role rows
summary: moves each voyage's captain settings to its own role row, and the flagship's to the fleet flagship role

execute.description: moves each voyage's captain settings to its own role row, and the flagship's to the fleet flagship role
execute.sql:
INSERT INTO "agentRoleSettings" ("scope", "role", "backend", "model", "effort")
             SELECT
               CASE WHEN "kind" = 'flagship' THEN 'fleet' ELSE "id" END,
               CASE WHEN "kind" = 'flagship' THEN 'flagship' ELSE 'captain' END,
               "captainBackend",
               "captainModel",
               "captainEffort"
             FROM "voyage"
